title: Game Developer
tagline: Make games: gameplay, physics, AI, graphics and the craft of fun.
about: Game developers combine programming, maths and design to build interactive worlds. Roles range from gameplay programming (how the game feels) to engine, graphics, tools and AI programming.
The best way in is a portfolio of small finished games. Finishing is the skill studios look for most.
day: Implement gameplay mechanics and player controls
